long_biography.plain_text:
De Michele has returned to Porto Cervo's annual Rolex maxi regatta since 2007. He has remained at the helm through successive campaigns, working with specialist tacticians and navigators. Changes to the sails helped sharpen his crew's performance. After one class win, he spoke of his wish to compete directly against faster rivals.

His programme has also included the Tre Golfi regatta, another demanding Mediterranean event. Organisers' entry lists place him in the maxi class, alongside crews from several countries. In 2025, his team won four races to take another Maxi 4 class title at Porto Cervo, continuing a series of victories spanning more than a decade.
